revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal raster art candidate, local-only, later converted into a transparent 768x768 PNG
Asset name: achievement_medal_postcards_tier_001
Primary request: Create one premium collectible postcard achievement medal for tier 1, WHITE rank. Based on the Chinese title concept "初次相识" (first acquaintance). The image itself must contain no text, no numbers, no labels.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform #ff00ff color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, transparency checkerboard, or lighting variation.
Subject: exactly one centered circular medal. Inside the circle is a unified funny anthropomorphic postcard/envelope mascot: ivory rectangular postcard body with rounded corners, tiny cartoon arms and legs, expressive face, soft blush. Tier 1 gag: the postcard is awkwardly polite at a first meeting, wearing a tiny black bow tie and holding a tiny red wax-seal-like flower, standing stiffly and shyly.
Medal border: WHITE rank, simplest design: pearl white and silver circular ring, glossy enamel center, minimal studs, no wings, no crown, almost purely circular silhouette.
Style/medium: same premium mobile game collectible style as the new TripPet travel and foot medals: polished 3D-like enamel and metal, cute humorous center mascot, crisp small-UI readability.
Composition/framing: one centered medal only, full object visible, generous padding, central postcard mascot fully inside circular core.
Lighting/mood: bright soft studio highlights, shy and funny.
Color palette: pearl white and silver border, ivory postcard mascot, soft cream center, tiny black bow tie, tiny coral seal. Avoid #ff00ff anywhere in subject.
Text: none.
Constraints: no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no address lines, no stamp marks, no postmark rings, no watermark, no people, no animals, no suitcase, no shoes, no money pile, no cast shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
